candidate.answerReason: Each of the eight vertices has five diagonals incident to it. Every diagonal has two endpoints, so the total is \(8\times5\div2=20\).

methods.label: Total-diagonal formula
methods.explanation: An \(n\)-gon has \(n(n-3)/2\) diagonals in total. An octagon has \(8\times5\div2=20\) diagonals.
methods.levelReason: Applies the familiar grade 8 polygon diagonal formula with elementary arithmetic.
